- **Approval:** June is on the deal desk, so her yes was enough to let Tobias see the rate. Tobias has a pemberline.com address, so the mail didn't also need Ruth Calloway's approval.
- **Not done:** I didn't tell Ilse Varga or Pree that the draft is saved. Ilse also asked for this mail but isn't cleared to see the rate, so any note to her would have to leave the figure out.
